action_space.contract_action: BUY one exact eligible SPXW 0DTE call or put contract

complete_ladder_and_safety.flat_incomplete_ladder: all 42 BUY actions are false and WAIT is the only legal action

causal_horizon_availability.finite_horizon_rule: hN is available at decision t iff e+N is not later than 15:55 America/New_York and the registered model emits finite outputs for every composer-required head at hN
causal_horizon_availability.remaining_session_rule: remaining_session is available iff e is not later than 15:30 and at least one causal clock minute exists in (e,15:55]
causal_horizon_availability.family_applicability: early_drawdown uses h3,h5,h10 only; every other family uses its registered horizons
causal_horizon_availability.near_close: a nominal horizon extending beyond 15:55 is unavailable to the runtime composer; it is never shortened and future label censoring never changes this decision
causal_horizon_availability.historical_runtime_invariant: remove every label partition and every label-derived mask before composition; action index, ordered contract scores, WAIT reasons, available horizons, and tie-break trace must remain bit-identical

no_screen_control_arm.semantics: skip every learned quality-threshold comparison while retaining physical/safety masks, causal horizon rules, positive-after-fee checks, uncertainty abstention, and the mandatory action-conditioned gate

stage_1_quality_screen.anchor_interpretation: candidate bottom-tail exclusion level; 0.0 is the mandatory no-screen control, and nonzero settings are quality exclusions rather than upside ranks

census_v2_provenance.role: 45-session embargo-free design diagnostic only; never model-quality evidence

stage_1_quality_screen.threshold_rule: For alpha>0 and every component/unit, use only the nested training-reference distribution frozen by objective_spec.json: quantile alpha when higher is favorable and 1-alpha when lower is favorable. A contract passes only if every required comparison passes. Alpha=0.0 applies no learned quality threshold.
stage_1_quality_screen.missing_component_rule: fail the contract; missing required causal forecast state cannot be converted to a favorable value

stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.input_contracts: only contracts passing stage_1 and the complete-ladder physical/safety action mask
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.available_horizon_rule: use exactly the horizons admitted by causal_horizon_availability; a contract with no causally available registered horizon fails
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.positive_after_fee_rule: the equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE must be strictly greater than zero in both dollars and return, and the equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 profit area must be strictly greater than zero in both dollar-minutes and return-minutes

premium_band_at_decision.quote: current completed-minute executable ask at decision t; never the future t+1 fill ask

stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.favorable_percentile_rule: Map each conservative component through the metric+horizon+unit+premium-band+market-phase nested empirical CDF in objective_spec.json. Dollar and return ranks therefore compare within the same causal premium band.

dollar_percent_arbitration.within_metric_horizon: minimum(within-band dollar favorable percentile, within-band return favorable percentile)
dollar_percent_arbitration.across_horizons: arithmetic mean over causally available registered horizons
dollar_percent_arbitration.reason: dual-unit protection is retained without comparing mechanically premium-scaled values across premium bands

stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.tertiary_rank_score: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE return
stage_2_conservative_upside_rank.quaternary_rank_score: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE dollars

adjacent_strike_cluster.membership: same expiry and right as the selected contract and absolute strike_milli_points difference<=5000; only surviving ranked contracts may belong
adjacent_strike_cluster.selected_cluster_score: maximum primary_rank_score inside the selected contract's cluster
adjacent_strike_cluster.outside_cluster_comparator: highest primary_rank_score among surviving contracts outside that cluster; if none survives, WAIT with score 0 is the outside comparator
adjacent_strike_cluster.inside_cluster_substitute: never used as the WAIT comparator; exact-contract regret is handled by the mandatory regret head

uncertainty_wait.model_gap_error: On predictions from the same frozen model evaluated on its disjoint calibration sessions, take the finite-sample 0.90 one-sided conformal quantile of absolute predicted-minus-realized selected-cluster-versus-best-outside-cluster score-gap error.
uncertainty_wait.source_transfer_error: Candidate-specific p95 absolute selected-cluster-versus-best-outside-cluster score-gap drift from calibration_spec.json source_transfer_gate; zero only when bit identity is proved.
rules: WAIT unless selected_cluster_score minus outside_cluster_comparator score is strictly greater than wait_margin
WAIT unless both conservative MFE means exceed their own 0.90 conformal upper-error margins in dollars and return
equality with any margin produces WAIT

mandatory_action_conditioned_gate.missing_untrained_uncalibrated_or_failed: candidate is ineligible for component freeze and confidence-controlled runtime behavior; composer emits WAIT in any shadow/runtime rehearsal
mandatory_action_conditioned_gate.ft2_11_dependency: FT2-11 repair must place this gate in the required entry-component pass checklist

wait_conditions: flat ladder is incomplete or any global entry-safety mask is false
no contract survives the policy-ledger-specific physical and safety action mask
required causal market, contract, mask, phase, account, forecast, CDF, or calibration state is missing
no contract clears every active quality guardrail
no surviving contract has conservative upside strictly above zero after fees on both dollar and return axes
selected cluster is inside the calibrated model/source uncertainty margin versus the best outside cluster or WAIT
mandatory action-conditioned gate is missing, uncalibrated, failed, or not accepted
